line.text: Three days on this plain, and not one Trojan in sight.

shots.motion_prompt: A wide shot of a Bronze Age army marching across a dusty golden plain at sunset. At the head of the column a grey-bearded general with a tall red crest on his boar's-tusk helmet and a younger dark-bearded commander walk side by side toward the camera; hundreds of spearmen with tall shields march behind them, a chariot rolls, dust glows in the low sun. The camera tracks slowly backward in front of them. Sound: heavy marching feet, clinking bronze, creaking chariot wheels, wind.
